name: dark-forest-terra-incognita
description: Тёмный Лес: Терра Инкогнита — browser idle MMO strategy

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.vercel-install: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:generate --prefix server && (cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy || echo 'WARN: migrate deploy skipped/failed — check DATABASE_URL') && npm run build --prefix client && node scripts/bundle-api.mjs
